FN-BVZEQQ-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 79
Committee: Boards, Agencies, and Sponsor: Representative Phillip Rigsby
Commissions
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 03/21/2023
House Bill 79 as introduced would require the registration of "designated representatives" of
certain permit holders with the Alabama Board of Pharmacy, including: (1) a fee of no less than
$100, as set by board rule, for initial registration and annual renewal; and (2) late fees, not to
exceed $50 per month until renewed. These provisions would increase receipts to the board by
an estimated minimum of $200,000 annually.
